  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the CA-issued card was used from GB and CVV failed. Card is the sole adverse family; Linkage is absent, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Travel and a new non-home destination offer a benign explanation, but the required id_check failed. Although the family evidence selects §6.6(b), §5.3(b) now decides the disposition: decline, not further verification or escalation. The order is unshipped, so decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. No further check would change the policy decision."
